Name: (CP) TV Back Sets
Author: LonelySheepling
Description:
Adds the backs of the 8 different TVs available in the game as furniture/decoration

-Non-interactable (decorative)
-Available in the furniture catalog
-Two different designs available for the tropical TV (I couldn't decide on one over the other)
-Two backs for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4799]Antique TV Sets[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Medinaquirin]Medinaquirin[/url]


This was originally made while I was procrastinating on my course projects.
Prior to making this I was neither a mod maker nor a pixel artist.

Notice:
I am currently working on making TV side sprites but they won't be done for awhile
1.2.0 changelog available in the LOGS tab

Here’s some other mods I’d recommend to go along with this:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11781]One Tile High Budget TV[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Aimon111]Aimon11[/url]
